problems.stem: What most clearly separates an AI spam filter from a calculator?
options: The spam filter learned its behavior from labelled examples; the calculator follows fixed rules.
The spam filter never makes mistakes.
problems.explanation: AI systems learn patterns from data. Fixed-rule tools do exactly what they were programmed to do.

problems.stem: A chatbot writes a strong essay outline. What does that show?
options: It has general intelligence and can do any task.
It is good at one kind of task, producing text, which is narrow AI.
It understands the topic the way an expert does.
It can be trusted on every fact in the outline.
problems.explanation: Fluent text shows skill at a narrow task. It is not evidence of general intelligence or of factual accuracy.

problems.stem: Which campus tool is most likely to use AI?
options: A library search that ranks results by relevance.
problems.explanation: Ranking search results by learned relevance is a common use of AI.
